# SLIIQQUE: full content for LLMs
Source: https://sliiqque.space/ (site facts below are kept in sync with the website).


> SLIIQQUE is a boutique software studio in Lagos, Nigeria, founded in 2021. It builds websites, AI bots and agents, workflow automation systems, and SaaS interfaces for founders and businesses worldwide. The studio takes on 2-3 new projects per quarter.

Key facts:
- Founder and lead engineer: Gabriel Njoabozia
- Location: Lagos, Nigeria (clients worldwide)
- Contact: hello@sliiqque.space
- Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL

## Services and pricing (USD, starting prices)
- Website Design & Development: from $300
- AI Bot & Agent Development (WhatsApp, Telegram, website AI agents): from $600
- Interface Engineering (SaaS and business interfaces): from $1,000
- Studio Retainer: from $2,500 per month, 40 hours per month
- Technical Audit: fixed $800


## FAQ

### What does SLIIQQUE do?
SLIIQQUE is a boutique software studio in Lagos, Nigeria, founded in 2021. We build websites, AI bots and agents, workflow automation systems, and SaaS interfaces for founders and businesses worldwide.

### How much does a website cost?
Website Design & Development starts from $300. Interface Engineering for SaaS and business products starts from $1,000. Final pricing depends on project scope.

### How much does an AI bot or agent cost?
AI Bot & Agent Development starts from $600. This covers WhatsApp and Telegram bots, AI agents embedded in your website for customer support and lead capture, and social platform automation.

### What is included in the Studio Retainer?
The Studio Retainer starts from $2,500 per month and includes 40 hours a month, priority access, strategy sessions, and ongoing support, so you have a dedicated engineering partner for websites, automation, and AI agents.

### What is a Technical Audit?
A Technical Audit is a fixed-price $800 review of your website, workflows, and tech stack. You receive a performance audit, an architecture review, a clear action plan, and an implementation guide that says what to fix, automate, or rebuild.

### How do you work with clients?
Every project follows four stages: Discovery, Architecture, Build, and Ship. Builds run in two-week focused sprints with daily updates and a shared workspace. We take on only 2-3 new projects per quarter.

### Do you work with clients outside Nigeria?
Yes. SLIIQQUE is based in Lagos and works with clients worldwide. Past work includes HR software, electricity payments, fraud prevention, and a real estate platform.
